record.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、LLM inference efficiencyとの接続、効果の一般性または技術的な新規性が弱く、理由を付してborderlineに残す。DiVA distills a voice assistant from a text-only LLM without instruction-response labels and reports >100x lower training compute plus a 72% preference win rate. This is training efficiency and voice-task quality, not a demonstrated inference-serving reduction
record.title: Distilling an End-to-End Voice Assistant Without Instruction Training Data
